类 FileStorage

java.lang.Object
FileStorage
public final class FileStorage extends Object
Central CSV persistence helper for the stand-alone demo.

The coursework requires simple text-file storage rather than a database, so every major entity is loaded from and saved to CSV files under data/. The class also seeds a small deterministic dataset when those files do not yet exist.

The implementation intentionally stays lightweight and dependency-free. It now includes a compact CSV parser/writer that preserves commas, quotes, and empty values while remaining compatible with the earlier plain rows already stored in the repository.

    • hashPassword

      public static String hashPassword(String plainText)
      Returns the SHA-256 hex digest of the given plain-text password.

      SHA-256 is always available in the Java SE runtime, so this method never throws a checked exception.

      参数:
      plainText - the plain-text password to hash
      返回:
      lowercase hex-encoded SHA-256 digest, 64 characters
